title: The Lost Kitten
body:
One Saturday morning, Mia heard a tiny sound coming from under the porch. She knelt down and peered into the dark space. Two green eyes blinked back at her. It was a kitten!

The kitten was small and scared. Mia ran inside and got a small bowl of milk. She set it near the opening of the porch and waited. After a few minutes, the kitten crept out and began to drink.

Mia sat very still so she would not frighten the kitten. She talked to it in a soft, gentle voice. Slowly, the kitten finished the milk and looked up at Mia. Then it walked right into her lap!

Mia was so happy. She carried the kitten inside and showed her mom. Her mother said the kitten could stay. Mia gave it a name right away. She called him Whiskers because his whiskers were very long.

From that day on, Whiskers and Mia were the best of friends. He followed her everywhere she went. When she did her homework at the kitchen table, Whiskers sat on the chair beside her. When she watched TV, he curled up on the couch. Mia was glad she had heard that tiny sound under the porch.

title: How Bees Help Us
body:
Bees are small insects, but they do a very big job. They help plants grow by moving pollen from one flower to another. This process is called pollination. Without bees, many of the foods we eat would not exist.

Bees live in large groups called colonies. A single colony can have thousands of bees. Each bee has a job to do. Some bees fly out to find flowers and collect nectar. Nectar is a sweet liquid found inside flowers. They bring the nectar back to the hive and turn it into honey.

One bee makes only a tiny amount of honey in its lifetime. It takes many bees working together to make enough honey for us to eat. That is why bees are known as hard workers.

Bees also help farmers. When bees visit farm crops like apples, cherries, and watermelons, they spread pollen that helps the fruit grow big and healthy. Farmers are glad to have bees nearby.

Sadly, bee numbers have been dropping in recent years. Scientists think pollution and changes in weather may be causing this. People can help by planting flowers in their yards and avoiding harmful chemicals. Every little bit helps these tiny heroes.
